A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study and contain readable main text, figures, equations, and Appendices A–L. The experiments and figures can be matched across the reorganization.

before.justification: v1 reports original causal-intervention, subspace, and attention-knockout results, including experiments on CausalToM, BigToM, and Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The lookback mechanisms and Appendix E pseudocode are unchanged. However, v2 adds a cross-entropy mask-training objective in Appendix D while retaining v1's negative-logit objective with sparsity regularization in Appendix F. The PDFs do not resolve whether this represents a procedural revision or inconsistent exposition.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate CausalToM with no visibility and explicit visibility, plus BigToM true- and false-belief scenarios. The expanded dataset rationale in v2 Appendix B does not introduce new evaluated coverage.

E2.justification: The same full-residual and DCM-subspace interventions are compared in corresponding experiments. No evaluated baseline or comparison method is added or removed; changes to background citations do not alter these comparisons.

E3.justification: The reported intervention procedures, IIA metric, correct-answer filtering, 80-pair samples, and DCM training/validation sizes and optimization budgets are retained. v2 newly specifies INT8 precision for the existing 405B experiments, without establishing a change from their earlier execution.

E4.justification: The source-freezing controls, separate character/object/query interventions, visibility attention knockouts, and attention-head/subspace alignment analyses are retained in Appendices G–J. The BigToM and 405B mechanism analyses also already appear in v1.

E5.justification: v2's reproducibility statement newly says that DCM random seeds are included with the code. Neither PDF lists seed values or reports repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests; additional runs are not established.

E6.justification: v1 Section 3 reports 95.7% no-visibility and 99% explicit-visibility accuracy for Llama-3-70B-Instruct; v2 replaces these numbers with a qualitative performance statement. The matched intervention plots, subspace dimensions, and appendix findings are retained, with no demonstrated performance improvement.

T1.justification: v2 Appendix D adds a formal cross-entropy alignment objective that is not equivalent to the retained Appendix F loss. Appendix F also introduces incompatible dimensions for the displayed mask multiplication: a d-by-500 basis matrix and a length-d mask. The existing causal-abstraction criterion, causal-model pseudocode, and attention-alignment derivations remain.

C1.justification: v2 explicitly frames the findings as evidence of a systematic solution to belief tracking and shifts the advertised broader implication from complex conditional reasoning to in-context reasoning. The three-lookback contribution and previously reported BigToM/405B generalization remain.

C2.justification: v2 Section 2 clarifies that pointer and address representations need not be identical and match after query/key transformations. Section 6 attributes unresolved visibility-payload semantics to the two-character setting, while Appendix B explains specific counterfactual limitations motivating CausalToM.

D1.justification: v2 newly documents INT8 precision for the 405B model and continuous mask training with clamping followed by rounding during evaluation. Its reproducibility statement describes repository contents and local/NDIF reproduction options. These are additional disclosures, not evidence that the existing experiments changed.

R1.justification: v2 adds Ullman (2023) and Yiwei Wu et al. (2025), removes the discussion and citations concerning prompting-based ToM improvements, and drops Wang et al. (2023). The main research positioning remains. Consolidating the duplicate FANToM references does not remove that cited work.

P1.justification: The main exposition is extensively rewritten. v2 separates the hypothesized causal model from its verification, presents answer-lookback experiments before binding-lookback experiments, revises terminology and explanations, and adds ethics, reproducibility, and LLM-use statements.

P2.justification: v1's combined Figure 2 becomes separate Figures 3 and 4 in v2. Main experiment figures gain explicit example/results panel labels, captions are substantially revised, and figures and appendix material are extensively rearranged within the ICLR layout. The underlying plots are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 makes the causal hypothesis and its experimental verification easier to distinguish and supplies useful precision and mask-implementation details. It also clarifies mechanism explanations and applicability limits. These gains are tempered by removal of the behavioral accuracy figures and newly inconsistent mask objectives and dimensions in Appendices D–F. With the empirical evidence otherwise retained, the overall improvement is limited.
